data.title: Sticker Contest: Check Out The Winners!
data.meta_title: Sticker Contest: Check Out The Winners!
data.content:
Recently, we asked you to create a brand-new in-game cosmetic Sticker for War Robots: Frontiers, and we received so many amazing submissions, it was tough to select only three winners!

All three winners will receive 300 WarpReals, and t.rexoraptor's Sticker will be added to the game!

First Place: t.rexoraptor

“I made three variations, not too accurate to an actual dinosaur, but it looks cool to me—hope you like it.”

Second Place: t_g_j

“In a society where War Robots dominate and art is fleeting, a Sticker becomes a symbol for the artists who remain undeterred. A reminder that even in a world of cold steel, the spirit and beauty of artistic expression can thrive."

Third Place: gundamstyle500

"Whilst the Titans are fighting battles over and over, the Titan AI has been observing and listening to the Pilots speak on the battlefield. Their catchphrases intrigued the Titans, so they decided to try something new and spice up their look.”

Thank you to everyone who submitted a Sticker, and stay tuned for more awesome contests and prizes!
